name: No dead_code allowance added
instruction: A change does not add an attribute that silences the dead_code lint.
relevant_when: A patch adds a Rust line containing 'dead_code' inside an attribute: #[allow(...)], #![allow(...)], #[expect(...)], #![expect(...)] or #[cfg_attr(..., allow(...))].
context: AGENTS.md forbids dead code and #[allow(dead_code)]. CI runs clippy with -D warnings, so silencing the lint is the only way unused code survives; remove the unused item instead. A dead_code allowance that already existed and is only moved or reindented by the change is not new.
scope_reason: The violation is an added attribute line; existing allowances in unchanged lines are out of scope.

checklist.name: no-added-dead-code-allowance
checklist.rule: No added line introduces allow(dead_code) or expect(dead_code) in any attribute form, including inside cfg_attr. Not applicable when an identical attribute is removed elsewhere in the same patch, meaning it was only moved.
